hero.title: AI Literacy Training
hero.tagline: Meet EU AI Act Article 4 requirements in just 4 hours
hero.body: Article 4 makes AI literacy a legal obligation for anyone designing, deploying, or overseeing AI. This tailored training gives your team the skills to use AI safely and effectively, avoids compliance risks, and provides documented proof for audits. Delivered in English, anywhere in Germany or Europe.
